findings.title: Member of the Technical Staff, Internal Agent
findings.summary: Staff-level role building V (internal agentic interface): intent/planning/tools, durable multi-system workflows, Slack/web/CLI surfaces, evals/observability, and shared agent primitives across Vercel.
findings.fit_summary: 10+ years fullstack TypeScript plus Panorama AI LLM product/platform leadership and Snap platform ownership match a staff agent harness spanning UI, APIs, queues, and production infra.
missing_gaps: Prior agent-harness frameworks (OpenClaw/Hermes/Pi) listed as plus, not evidenced
Internal multi-surface agent product shipping at Vercel scale
evidence: Greenhouse: 7+ years SWE, strong TypeScript, full-stack + infra/queues/DB/permissions
Remote - United States; SF band $208k–$312k; New listing

findings.title: Software Engineer, AI SDK
findings.summary: Build and maintain Vercel's open-source TypeScript AI SDK for AI-native apps and agents; OSS community engagement and platform integration.
findings.fit_summary: Published SDK leadership (Snap ARES Web SDK) plus LLM product eng at Panorama AI map cleanly to a TypeScript AI SDK with external developer consumers.
findings.location: Remote (US; hybrid SF/NYC only if within office commute)
missing_gaps: Prior contributions specifically to Vercel AI SDK / similar OSS AI toolkits
evidence: Greenhouse JD: 5+ years, JS/TS + modern frontend, OSS participation
JD: beyond office commute distance → fully remote (Denver qualifies)

findings.title: Software Engineer, Dashboard
findings.summary: Founding fullstack engineer on Dashboard rebuild: shell/navigation, personalization APIs, agent-powered control-plane surfaces in React/TypeScript/Next.js.
findings.fit_summary: React/TS/Node fullstack and developer-facing product surfaces (SDKs, Studio-like control planes) plus LLM product experience fit an agent-powered Dashboard rearchitecture.
findings.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City
missing_gaps: Listed hybrid hubs are SF/NYC (away from Denver)
Next.js-specific dashboard shell ownership not a resume headline
evidence: Greenhouse: 4+ years fullstack React/TS/Next + APIs/DB; new team rebuilding Dashboard

findings.title: Software Engineer, Deployment Infrastructure
findings.summary: Senior CI/CD / deployment platform ownership: TypeScript services, AWS, Terraform, high-scale build pipelines and APIs that power Vercel deploys.
findings.fit_summary: Terraform/AWS cloud ownership from Vertebrae→Snap plus TypeScript backend/platform leadership match build/deploy infrastructure with IaC and end-to-end ownership.
findings.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City
missing_gaps: Listed offices SF/NYC (away from Denver); vercel.com careers lists NYC/SF
CI/CD platform at millions-of-builds/day scale not evidenced
evidence: Verified Greenhouse + vercel.com/careers: 6+ years distributed systems, JS/TS, AWS, Terraform
Hybrid SF/NYC; on-call for critical build systems

findings.title: Software Engineer, Backend
findings.summary: US-remote backend role: TypeScript/Node services for identity/membership (SCIM/SSO/OAuth), SQL/NoSQL, AWS, Terraform/K8s, enterprise security.
findings.fit_summary: TypeScript/Node, SQL, AWS, and Terraform experience fit the core stack, though the JD's center of gravity is identity/SSO lifecycle rather than general product backend.
missing_gaps: RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC access-control models as primary focus
evidence: Greenhouse: Remote US; TS/React/Node + security/SSO + Terraform/K8s
Beyond-commute remote language also present on JD

findings.title: Software Engineer, Workflows
findings.summary: Build Workflow Development Kit and Vercel Workflows platform with AI enablement: durable agent workflows, observability, state/resume semantics.
findings.fit_summary: Event-driven pipelines and LLM product systems at Panorama AI plus TypeScript platform work align with durable AI workflow primitives, with less evidence of workflow-engine internals.
findings.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City
missing_gaps: Durable workflow engines / WDK-style state machines not a resume headline
evidence: Greenhouse: 5+ years, JS/TS, AI/ML or durable systems (agents/queues/state machines)

findings.title: Software Engineer, AI Gateway
findings.summary: Backend platform for AI Gateway: unified multi-provider model API, rate limits, failovers, low-latency reliability across OpenAI/Anthropic/Google and more.
findings.fit_summary: TypeScript backend/cloud and LLM product integration experience help, but dedicated API-gateway/rate-limit/failover systems are a thinner resume match than SDK or agent product roles.
findings.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City
missing_gaps: High-throughput API gateway / multi-provider failover ownership
evidence: Greenhouse: 5+ years, JS/TS backend/APIs/cloud, AI/ML integrations or gateways

findings.title: Software Engineer, Agent
findings.summary: Build customer-facing Vercel Agent: autonomous investigate/fix for builds and prod issues, multi-step tool use, sandboxed code execution, dashboard/CLI/Slack surfaces.
findings.fit_summary: Staff TypeScript + LLM/platform background fit agentic remediation systems; NYC hybrid listing and deep Vercel platform-internals bar pull the score down vs US-remote MTS Internal Agent.
missing_gaps: Hybrid NYC office expectation (away from Denver)
Deep day-to-day Vercel deploy/CDN/DNS/log internals for agent tools
evidence: Greenhouse: 7+ years, strong TypeScript (Python-to-TS OK), fullstack + CI/CD/observability
Hybrid New York City listing; updated 2026-08-04
